layers.assessor_rule: optional additive properties year_built, stories, struct_class (Assessor construction_type code, raw) from the pinned roll year; a parcel centroid is joined to the smallest footprint containing it; most common value per footprint; parts inherit their structure's; absent when unknown
layers.base_rule: base_navd88_m = 10th percentile of the surface along the footprint ring (1 m steps); ground_min_navd88_m = minimum under the footprint; walls reach ground_min - skirt
layers.exclusion_rule: kept as records, not extruded: location=underground, or layer<0 with building:levels:underground or level<0 (underground stations), building=ship; parts inherit their structure's exclusion
layers.height_fill_rule: T-020b: only a building whose R-004 chain ended at default is re-resolved: (a) lidar_3dep = median over 1 m cells inside the footprint eroded 1.0 m of (3DEP first-return p95 - terrain), needs >= 0.7 of cells with returns, mean multi-return share <= 0.3 (vegetation test) and height >= 2.0 m; (b) assessor_stories = stories x metres_per_level; (c) else default. height_source is lidar_3dep / assessor_stories for filled buildings
layers.owner_rule: a structure is owned by the tile containing its shapely point_on_surface; its parts follow it; geometry is not clipped
layers.part_height_rule: R-004 order per part; a part height from a fallback (datasf/levels/default) is capped at its structure's height when that is osm_height or datasf (height_capped_to_parent)
layers.remainder_rule: a structure with building:part ways renders through its parts plus remainder_geometry (outline minus parts, slivers < 4 m^2 or < 0.6 m wide dropped) extruded with the outline's own height_m
layers.roof_rule: max(y) = base_navd88_m + height_m for every roof_shape; M0 renders flat roofs except pyramidal/spire/cone with roof:height (apex at height_m)
